title: STORM ENTRY: Mass Hero Entry BGM (original score)
description:
A temple festival at night. The villain has silenced the drums and the whole village stands afraid in the rain. Then thunder cracks, a chain drags across the stone... and he walks in.

A mass hero entry score in South Indian film style: thunder booms, a nadaswaram and synth duel, thavil rolls, crowd chants and a hook that comes back bigger every time. Use it for hero entry edits, mass scenes and goosebump moments. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Storm Entry, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
